# Proofa — Free Receipt & Invoice Generator in Nigeria

> Proofa (https://www.proofa.ng) is a fast, web-based receipt, invoice, and order summary maker designed specifically for Nigerian and African small businesses, merchants, freelancers, and online vendors.

## Core Capabilities
- **Instant Receipt Generation**: Create professional customer payment receipts with transaction IDs, itemized lists, and payment methods (Bank Transfer, Cash, POS, Card).
- **Invoice Generation**: Issue commercial invoices with due dates, VAT (7.5% Nigerian rate), and bank account details.
- **Order Summaries**: Generate packing slips and delivery orders for Instagram, WhatsApp, and TikTok vendors.
- **Social Sharing**: One-tap direct sharing to WhatsApp, Instagram DM, and TikTok. Downloadable as high-resolution images (PNG) and PDF.
- **Localized for Nigeria**: Native support for Nigerian Naira (₦ / NGN) and USD ($), Nigerian bank account vaults (Zenith, GTBank, Access, Kuda, OPay, Moniepoint, PalmPay, etc.).
- **Pricing**: Free tier available with no registration required. Pro and Business plans available for custom branding, logo upload, watermark removal, and multi-device sync.

## Target Audience
- Nigerian Instagram and TikTok vendors
- WhatsApp merchants and boutique sellers
- Freelancers and digital service providers in Nigeria
- SME retailers, supermarkets, and physical stores needing clean digital receipts

## Key Links
- [Receipt Generator](https://www.proofa.ng/receipt): Create instant receipts online.
- [Invoice Generator](https://www.proofa.ng/invoice): Create customer invoices with VAT and payment terms.
- [Order Summary Maker](https://www.proofa.ng/order): Delivery and fulfillment slips for social commerce.
- [Pricing](https://www.proofa.ng/pricing): Free vs Pro (₦2,500/mo) vs Business (₦5,000/mo).
